correctness.rationale: Checked Newton Minkowski-sum fan rays (1,0),(0,1),(−1,m),(0,−1), unimodular Cox matrix, and explicit graph chart u3=1−u1, u4=1−u2[u1^m+(1−u1)^m]. Thus U_m≅A² and U_m° is complement of x(1−x)y(1−yh_m(x))=0. Roots of h_m are m distinct if m even, m−1 if odd, with m=0,1 constants; fourth divisor is A¹ with r_m punctures and four transverse nodes. Compact-support cohomology and Alexander duality give H1=Z⁴,H2=Z^{4+r_m}; Euler r_m+1. Critical y elimination yields degree-r_m+1 polynomial R_m=(a(1−x)−cx)h_m−b x(1−x)h_m', generic squarefree and disjoint from deleted divisors, with nondegenerate lifts. Independently checked degrees, squarefreeness, generic counts for m=0..12; finite checks do not extend to all m. Source cites general result as Theorem 3.9, whereas inspected primary identifies the needed construction around Theorem 3.7/Corollary 3.9; this is a citation-number imprecision, not a mathematical failure.
